Good, `dist/` is gitignored. Everything is in order: lint, tests, and build all pass, working tree is clean of temp artifacts, and the output JSON is written.

## Summary

Built the full Contract Tracker screen (`T-TRACKER-PAGE-UI`):

- **`TrackerPage`** at `/tracker`, role-gated (Tenant Admin / Contract Owner / Legal Reviewer / Approver) with redirect to the existing `/access-denied` page for everyone else, breadcrumb + header + Export matching IMG-1.
- **`TrackerReportControlsPanel`** — Period (mandatory), Contract Type/Owner filters (tenant lookups + All), Date Range From/To with validation.
- **`OwnershipTab`**, **`CycleTimeTab`** (table + bar chart), **`BottleneckTab`** (stuck-flag badges), **`TurnaroundTab`** (color-coded variance, "Not Set"/"AI Suggested" labels, inline override) — each with loading/error/empty/populated states.
- **`TrackerExportButton`** with failure-message handling that never disturbs the current view.
- New `trackerService.js` (7 endpoints), 8 hooks, and `trackerFiltersSlice` (resets on every open, per BR-013).

Verified: lint, full 131-test suite (5 new), production build all pass; visually confirmed against the design via a temporary mock backend + Playwright screenshot — the Ownership tab is a close match to IMG-1.

Key judgment calls (recorded in `blockers` in the output JSON):
- Reused the existing `GET /api/v1/dashboard/filters` endpoint for filter dropdown options, since this module has no tracker-specific lookup endpoint.
- Treated `BottleneckThresholdResponse` as an array (the DTO is singular but the data is "per stage").
- Cycle Time/Bottleneck/Turnaround tabs and the turnaround-override UI were built from DTOs/acceptance criteria since no design image depicts them.

Result written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-TRACKER-PAGE-UI.json`.
